summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and Tuple[ControlType, str] to ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added to tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests were not run, per instructions, and nothing was committed.
